svg.title: My ninja way
svg.desc: Hunter stands back to back with Naruto beside three things they build: living interfaces, motion with a story arc, and enterprise-grade data flows.

g.text: Full-stack developer by day, anime-web shinobi by night.
Responsive, pixel-perfect builds in HTML, CSS, JavaScript & React
Scroll-driven scenes, transitions and micro-interactions with GSAP
Robust backend APIs, microservices & scalable systems that never fail
“I don't watch anime. I code anime.”
